placeholders.{date}: Formatted month/day or month/day with weekday string (e.g. 10/12 or 10/12 (Mon)) in calendar titles, ARIA labels, toasts, stale timestamps, and capture prefills.
placeholders.{from}: First day of the visible week formatted by dayShort() (e.g. 10/12) in calendar.weekOf.
placeholders.{to}: Last day of the visible week formatted by dayShort() (e.g. 10/18) in calendar.weekOf.
placeholders.{n}: Event count on Day or Week card headers (calendar.countLabel*) or folded past-event count on Today's timeline (calendar.pastFold*).
placeholders.{time}: 24-hour local HH:MM clock string (nowAria, syncedLabel yesterdayAt/dateAt, weekEventTooltip, relativeStart) or formatted sync timestamp in calendarShared.staleShowing.
placeholders.{hours}: Whole or half-hour free-slot duration string from slotHours() (e.g. 1, 1.5, 4) in calendar.gapHours*.
placeholders.{start}: 24-hour local start time HH:MM of a free slot in calendar.gapRange, calendar.addInGapAria, and calendarPrefill.slot.
placeholders.{end}: 24-hour local end time HH:MM of a free slot in calendar.gapRange, calendar.addInGapAria, and calendarPrefill.slot.
placeholders.{label}: Suggested Today queue gap description in calendar.scheduleAria or localized action name in calendarShared.actionFailed.
placeholders.{habit}: Linked active habit name offered for one-tap check-in on an agenda row (calendar.habitAfter, calendar.checkIn).
placeholders.{title}: Calendar event or assignment title in ARIA labels, edit/delete toasts, weekly delete menu, week tooltips, and Tidy controls.
placeholders.{when}: 24-hour start or range clock string in calendar.editBlockAria* or formatted day/time phrase in calendarServerErrors.created*.
placeholders.{meta}: Optional weekly recurrence phrase (e.g. Every Mon) appended in calendar.editBlockAriaWithMeta.
placeholders.{weekday}: Localized short weekday label (Sun-Sat in en) in calendarModel.dayTitle.
placeholders.{weekly}: Localized weekly recurrence label (Every Sun-Every Sat in en) in calendarModel.weekEventTooltip.weekly.
placeholders.{m}: Minute count (1-59) until today's next event starts in calendarModel.relativeStart.
placeholders.{h}: Hour count (>= 1) until today's next event starts in calendarModel.relativeStart.
placeholders.{reason}: Underlying server or network error message interpolated into actionFailed and undoFailed toasts.
placeholders.{max}: Maximum allowed character count (200 for title/location, 4000 for notes) in calendarServerErrors.*TooLong*.

budgets.layoutNote: Measured against AppShell.css, precise.css, PageHead.css, CalendarPage.css, SegmentedControl.css, Button.css, Card.css, GuidePage.css, and ShortcutList.css at 320px (288px .page inner width, 254px .card inner width) and 360px (328px .page inner width, 294px .card inner width): (1) Calendar toolbar (.cal-bar at <= 720px): .cal-range wraps to its own full-width first row; row 2 shares 288px at 320px between SegmentedControl ('Day' 3 chars + 'Week' 4 chars = ~115px even with 14px coarse-pointer button padding), 12px gap, and .cal-nav (two 44px coarse-pointer icon buttons + 4px gaps + 'Today' 5-char sm button ~59px = ~151px), totaling ~278px <= 288px with zero overflow. (2) PageHead primary action 'Add event' (9 chars, ~102px) wraps onto its own action row below <= 720px and sits cleanly inline above 720px. (3) AgendaTimeline .tl-time (42px column + 12px gap) fits 'All day' (7 chars, ~50px in 12px mono, clearing the 3px .tl-bar) and WeekGrid --wk-label (48px) fits 'All day' (~38px in 12px sans); .gap-box (185px at 320px, 225px at 360px, flex-wrap: wrap) fits 'Schedule' (8 chars, ~78px) and 'Add event' (9 chars, ~103px). (4) EventEditor (.ev-pop.is-sheet: 288px inner width at 320px, 328px at 360px; .ev-pop popover: >= 266px): primary actions 'Save' (52px) + 'Cancel' (65px) + 'Delete event' (117px) + gaps total ~246px <= 266px on a single row, wrapping cleanly when 'Open link' (99px) is also present; weekly removal actions 'Delete this one' (15 chars, ~134px) and 'Delete weekly series' (20 chars, ~148px) fit on one row at 360px (~288px <= 328px), wrap cleanly at 320px, and keep RemoveMenu (.rm-pop, white-space: nowrap) at ~160px << 296px viewport cap. (5) Guide CardHead (.card-head has display: flex without wrap, and both h2 and .link have white-space: nowrap, leaving 206px for h2 + .link at 320px and 246px at 360px): pairing 'Keyboard shortcuts' (18) + 'Appearance' (10) (~186px), 'How AI helps' (12) + 'Daily brief' (11) (~149px), and 'Data & privacy' (14) + 'Privacy settings' (16) (~190px) keeps every CardHead <= 190px <= 206px at 320px while the card body prose spells out the full 'Settings › Appearance', 'Settings › Daily brief', and 'Settings › Data & privacy' paths.

rationale: Preserves every shipped zh-TW string from commit 0ab616c1769bb6090bb6a7fd545b19fbe5d451f2 byte-for-byte across calendar.ts, guide.ts, common.ts, and server/features/calendar so existing unit and render tests (calendar-model.test.ts, event-editor.test.ts, AgendaTimeline.test.ts, WeekGrid.test.ts, calendar.test.ts, edit.test.ts, repeat.test.ts) pass with zero regression.

Expands conditional template functions (CALENDAR.editBlockAria and WeekGrid eventLabel) into explicit static leaf keys with 100% placeholder parity and adds *One singular companions wherever English requires singular/plural agreement (countLabelOne, gapHoursOne, pastFoldOne, relativeStart.minutesOne/hoursOne, and server *TooLongOne limits).

Enforces SIGNOFF-copy-2026-11-09.md section 3 strictly: place references to the Today page use capitalized 'Today' in English and receive ready-to-wire zh-TW place-name updates in todayPlaceFixes, while calendar-date references keep date wording ('today' lowercase in English prose, 'Today' on standalone calendar date controls).

Aligns #/calendar and #/guide 100% with BELL Personal's shipped Today, Habits, Events, Quick Capture, and Onboarding glossary: Today, Quick note, Tasks, Calendar, Ideas, Habits, School & Projects, Settings › Appearance, Settings › Daily brief, Settings › Data & privacy, ChatGPT, Claude, AI brief, and Quick summary.

Rewrites technical AI and privacy bullets on #/guide into warm, Apple-style beginner prose in English with zero developer sign-in or command-line jargon, zero CJK characters in en or $meta, zero forbidden synonyms for Ideas, and zero em dashes across the entire file.
assumptions: Primary zh-TW keys preserve exact 0ab616c1 bytes for non-regression. Per SIGNOFF-copy-2026-11-09.md section 3: calendarPageHead.title, calendar.today (date jump button inside Navigate dates), calendar.emptyToday, calendar.googleReconnect, calendar.todayMark, calendarPrefill.today, guide.daily.steps.step1.body (queue group), guide.daily.steps.step5.body (endmark quote), and shortcutLabels.habits.label are calendar-date uses and keep date wording; calendar.todayTitle is already place-compliant in 0ab616c1; calendar.backToToday, guide.daily.steps.step1.title, guideShared.help.scopes.{list,habits}, and shortcutLabels.{capture,goToday} are Today place-name uses whose updated zh-TW strings are provided in todayPlaceFixes.

Array-valued sections in src/copy/guide.ts (GUIDE.daily.steps, GUIDE.ai.points, GUIDE.privacy.points) are represented as ordered keyed objects (step1-step5, point1-point4) so every leaf in the JSON spec has an explicit addressable key path; engineers can pass Object.values(...) directly to preserve the exact runtime array shapes.

CALENDAR.editBlockAria(when, title, meta) is split into calendar.editBlockAria (when meta is empty) and calendar.editBlockAriaWithMeta (when meta is non-empty) so no conditional separator logic remains hidden inside copy functions.
In calendarPrefill.today, English uses lowercase 'today' ('+today 15:30-16:30 '), which shared/capture-parse.ts line 417 matches case-insensitively right after '+'.

GuidePage.tsx renders HELP.intro, ShortcutList (HELP.scopes, HELP.then, SHORTCUT_LABELS), and AiTag ('summary' and 'rule') from src/copy/common.ts alongside PAGE_HEADS.guide and GUIDE; guideShared and shortcutLabels include all of them so #/guide renders 100% in English under ?lang=en.

step1.title: 打開今天
step1.body: 信件、作業、審查、活動和待辦排成一個佇列，分成最重要、今天內和可以等。

step2.title: 從游標那一列開始
step2.body: 最上面那一列已經展開，主要動作就在第一顆按鈕；按 ↵ 或點一下就完成。

step3.title: 處理完就往下
step3.body: 封存、完成、延後或略過後，那一列會離開，游標自動移到下一列；6 秒內都能復原。

step4.title: 想到什麼先記下
step4.body: 按 N 或點「快速記下」，寫「明天 9:00 交報告」這樣的句子，會自動變成待辦、行程或靈感。

step5.title: 看到版面結尾就收工
step5.body: 「今天的版面到這裡。」代表沒有別的了；習慣另外打卡，不算在佇列裡。

ai.title: AI 怎麼幫忙

points.point1: AI 只提出建議：分類信件、整理今日摘要、從信裡找出活動和待辦。要不要採用，都由你點一下決定；不會自動封存、寄信或建立任何東西。
points.point2: 用的是伺服器上你自己登入的 Claude Code 或 Codex，不需要另外的 API 金鑰；可以在每日摘要設定切換。
points.point3: AI 沒有回應時，頁面不會等它：摘要改用規則整理，標示「規則整理」，並說明原因。
points.point4: 送去整理的只有必要的片段（信件主旨、寄件者和摘錄、行程標題），而且只交給你自己的 CLI。

ai.tagAi: 由 AI 產生，請自己判斷。
ai.tagRule: AI 沒有參與，依固定規則整理。

points.point1: 所有資料都存在這台電腦；Google、E3、Canvas 的憑證另外加密保存，瀏覽器不會存任何密碼。
points.point2: 信件只保存摘要和一小段純文字，預設 30 天後自動刪除；信本身一直留在你的 Gmail。
points.point3: 可以隨時匯出全部資料，或清除快取的信件。
points.point4: 中斷 Google 連線會撤銷授權並刪除快取；也可以到 Google 帳戶的第三方存取權移除。

step1.title: Open Today
step1.body: Mail, assignments, reviews, events, and Tasks line up in one queue, grouped into Most important, Today, and Can wait.

step2.title: Start at the highlighted row
step2.body: The top row opens ready to go, with its main action on the first button. Press ↵ or select it to finish.

step3.title: Keep moving down the list
step3.body: Archive, complete, snooze, or skip an item and focus moves straight to the next row. You have 6 seconds to undo.

step4.title: Jot thoughts down right away
step4.body: Press N or choose Quick note and type a line like “Submit report tomorrow 9:00”. BELL sorts it into Tasks, Calendar, or Ideas.

step5.title: Wrap up at the end mark
step5.body: “That's all for today.” means nothing else is waiting. Habits are checked in separately and don't count toward the queue.

ai.title: How AI helps

points.point1: AI only suggests: sorting mail, writing your daily brief, and spotting events or Tasks. You decide what to keep in one tap; nothing is archived, sent, or created on its own.
points.point2: Uses the ChatGPT or Claude account signed in on this computer, with no separate key to manage. Switch anytime in Settings › Daily brief.
points.point3: If AI doesn't respond, the page never waits around: your brief falls back to built-in rules, shows “Quick summary”, and explains why.
points.point4: Only essential snippets are shared (mail subjects, senders, short excerpts, and event titles), and only with your own signed-in ChatGPT or Claude connection on this computer.

ai.tagAi: Generated by AI. Use your own judgment.
ai.tagRule: Organized by fixed rules, without AI.

points.point1: Everything stays on this computer. Your Google, E3, and Canvas sign-in details are stored encrypted, and your browser never saves any passwords.
points.point2: For mail, only a summary and a short plain-text excerpt are kept, and they clear automatically after 30 days by default. Your messages stay safely in Gmail.
points.point3: Export all your data or clear saved mail previews anytime in Settings › Data & privacy.
points.point4: Disconnecting Google revokes access and clears saved copies right away. You can also remove BELL under third-party access in your Google Account.
